segments: The precision path. The airborne circle shots and fireplace route are the parts most runs lose time on.
Red symbol at the top of the Clock Tower spiral stairs
Shoot the glowing red symbol near the top of the Clock Tower spiral stairs with the base bow and collect the broken arrow.
After the Rocket Test finishes, quickly shoot the glowing heated rock on the building at the Rocket Platform. This activates the ritual circles.
Use the Wunderspheres and shoot each faded ritual circle while you are in the air: Clock Tower area, Death Ray area, and the route between spawn and Double Tap.
Stand inside each lit circle and kill zombies until that circle erupts and finishes charging.
Return to the Clock Tower clockwork and interact to reveal the symbol that identifies the fireplace you must hit.
Route the flame to the fireplace

From the active ritual circle, you have four total shots to move the volcanic rock to the matching fireplace. The first shot spawns the rock; make each later shot from the red-aura landing point and put the final shot into the fireplace. Interact with the fireplace when it lights.
Return to the Death Ray / floating fire interaction and complete the final fire step to receive the reforged arrow.
Place the forged arrow into the Fire altar, feed zombie souls, insert the base bow, and collect the upgraded Fire Bow.
Practice the Wundersphere circle shots before attempting a speed run.
The fireplace route allows four total shots — plan the landing points before firing.
